title: Compact starter canvas and request-builder flow for Hosted API quickstart
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design and deliver a compact set of starter cards and an inline request-builder for the Hosted API quickstart. This ticket covers producing responsive screenshots and annotated assets for docs and the console: model quick-swap card, a condensed request composer with advanced disclosure, and three code-snippet variants (curl, Python, Node). The focus is on a minimal, scannable canvas for first-time users and small-screen layouts for the docs landing page. Produce final PNG/JPEG assets, a short GIF for model swap flow, and an annotation PDF for engineering and docs to reference.
acceptance_criteria: Three compact starter card variants produced: Single-column mobile, two-column tablet, and desktop inline tile
Request builder screenshot showing prefilled sensible defaults (model, temperature, max_tokens) and an open ‘Advanced’ disclosure with batching/kv-cache toggle
Code snippets present in three variants: cURL, Python (requests), Node (fetch) and each screenshot shows token-estimate badge
All screenshots include accessible alt text and are exported at 2x for docs; PNG and JPEG copies included
Annotated PDF with callouts (element purpose, aria text, copy text) delivered to Drive and linked in the ticket
Figma file updated with named components and export presets; a short GIF (model quick-swap) added for the release notes
Design review sign-off from PM and engineering (see reviewers).
comments: 2026-03-10 Ava Martinez: Initial brief — aim for the smallest scannable card that still communicates model choice, sample prompt, and estimated cost. Keep advanced options hidden by default.

2026-03-11 Lena Ko: Exploratory comps uploaded to Figma. Two directions: (A) badge-first card emphasizing model performance, (B) prompt-first card emphasizing examples. Leaning towards (B) for docs clarity.

2026-03-12 Priya Patel: Engineering concern — model quick-swap animation should be a lightweight GIF (no Lottie) and we need separate assets for low-bandwidth users. Also flagged token-estimate as computed server-side; placeholder shown in screenshots is acceptable.
2026-03-12 Marcus Chen: PM review — prefer prompt-first (B) but include a micro-badge for latency/cost. Will test copy variants in the release notes.
2026-03-13 Ethan Brooks: Docs note — add alt text and short captions for each asset; include copy for the caption that explains which SDK snippet to use for quickstarts.
